principles: Admiral defines whether a Fleet capability is Standard or Paid.
Owners may request eligible paid services but cannot self-grant or self-activate them.
Standard capability status does not broaden vessel data scope.
Every service remains vessel-entitled and RLS-scoped.
Captain operationalizes only capabilities the Fleet has entitled for the vessel.

objects.entitlement: commercial and authority grant connecting one vessel to one capability
objects.request: owner expression of interest; never authority by itself
